text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Toronto Investment Board ("Board") with a review of the global equity mandates and explain the rationale underlying the selection of investment managers for this asset class. A presentation by the investment consultant (Aon) provides background and decision making of the Toronto Investment Board (Board) in 2018.
The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Received the report (August 30, 2024) from the Director, Capital Markets for information.
